# SEPTA Transit Alerts — full reference

> An unofficial public archive of SEPTA (Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority) service alerts and detected disruptions across SEPTA Metro, buses, and Regional Rail. Not affiliated with SEPTA. This file expands on [/llms.txt](__SITE_ORIGIN__/llms.txt) with the full data schema.

## What this site is

A collector polls SEPTA's public APIs about every 10 minutes and records:

- **Official alerts** from SEPTA's alerts feed — service advisories, real-time alerts, and short-term (≤72h) bus detours across SEPTA Metro, bus, and Regional Rail. Long-running construction detours and station-amenity notices (parking, ticket offices, waiting rooms) are excluded. Each alert is an incident from when SEPTA posted it until it leaves the feed or its stated end passes.
- **Regional Rail delays** — trains SEPTA's TrainView feed reports running 15+ minutes late; active while late, resolved when the train recovers or arrives.
- **Regional Rail cancellations** — trains SEPTA marks cancelled, anchored to the scheduled departure.
- **Bus and Metro trip cancellations** — trips SEPTA marks CANCELED in its GTFS-realtime trip feed (often hours ahead), one incident per route per service day (`trip-cancellations-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<route>`), active until the last cancelled trip's scheduled end.
- **Detected disruptions** — live bus, trolley, and M1 positions (TransitView) compared with SEPTA's GTFS schedule: gaps, bunching, missing vehicles, and vehicles held in place (see the glossary below). A condition must hold on two consecutive ~10-minute checks to open and be absent for two to resolve. When SEPTA has an active, unplanned alert on the same route, the detection is attached to that incident (`sources: ["septa", "bot"]`); otherwise it's a bot-only incident with an id like `gap-2026-10-06-17-0-0745`. The subway lines (L1, B1–B3) report no positions and get no position-based detections.
- **Elevator outages** at SEPTA Metro and Regional Rail stations (separate `accessibility.json`).

Every incident has a `mode` of `metro`, `bus`, or `regional_rail`. Route keys:

- SEPTA Metro: `l1` (Market-Frankford), `b1`/`b2`/`b3` (Broad Street Line, Express, Broad-Ridge Spur), `m1` (Norristown High Speed Line), `t1`–`t5` (subway-surface trolleys), `g1` (Girard Ave trolley), `d1`/`d2` (Media and Sharon Hill trolleys).
- Bus: SEPTA route ids with spaces hyphenated — `17`, `K`, `LUCYGO`, `L1-OWL`, `T-Bus`.
- Regional Rail: lowercase route codes — `air`, `che`, `chw`, `cyn`, `fox`, `lan`, `med`, `nor`, `pao`, `tre`, `war`, `wil`, `wtr`.

## Endpoints

- Recent incidents JSON: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/alerts-recent.json (active + last 93 days)
- Archive index JSON: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/alerts-index.json
- Monthly shards: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/alerts/<YYYY-MM>.json (incidents first seen that Philadelphia month)
- Per-line files: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/incidents/by-line/<key>.json (all-time, one line/route)
- Year-over-year aggregates: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/aggregates.json
- Daily counts JSON: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/daily-counts.json
- Accessibility outages JSON: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/accessibility.json
- Incidents CSV: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/alerts.csv
- Data changelog: __SITE_ORIGIN__/data/CHANGELOG.md
- Atom feed: __SITE_ORIGIN__/feed.xml (per-line/route: /feed/line/<line>.xml, /feed/route/<route>.xml, /feed/rail/line/<line>.xml)
- JSON feed: __SITE_ORIGIN__/feed.json
- API catalog (RFC 9264 linkset): __SITE_ORIGIN__/.well-known/api-catalog

## Incident shape

Every incident-bearing file (`alerts-recent.json`, the monthly shards, the per-line files) carries `schema_version: 2`, `generated_at`, `data_start_ts`, and an `incidents[]` array of objects shaped like:

```jsonc
{
  "id": "alert-136615",               // stable permalink id; /event/:id
  "agency": "septa",
  "mode": "metro",                    // "metro", "bus", or "regional_rail"
  "routes": ["b1", "b2", "b3"],
  "sources": ["septa"],               // "septa" (official alert) and/or "bot" (detection)
  "lifecycle": {
    "first_seen_ts": 1790880991000,   // when SEPTA posted it (or first detection)
    "resolved_ts": null,              // null = still open
    "active": true,
    "duration_ms": null
  },
  "official_alert": {                 // null for bot-only incidents
    "id": "136615",                   // SEPTA's alert id ("D17471" for detours)
    "headline": "Shuttle Busing Between Olney and Fern Rock Transit Center",
    "description": "Bus service replaces trains from Olney to Fern Rock …",
    "post_url": null,
    "source_url": "https://www.septa.org/schedules/B1",
    "resolved_reply_url": null,
    "lifecycle": { /* same fields as above */ },
    "scope": {
      "from_station": "Olney Transit Center",
      "to_station": "Fern Rock Transit Center",
      "stations": ["Olney Transit Center", "Fern Rock Transit Center"], // full stretch
      "direction": null,
      "mentioned_stations": ["Olney Transit Center", "Fern Rock Transit Center"]
    },
    "agency_event_window": {          // SEPTA's stated start/end
      "start_ts": 1791607500000,
      "end_ts": 1791792000000,
      "start_is_date_only": false,
      "end_is_date_only": false
    },
    "septa": { "type": "ADVISORY", "cause": "MAINTENANCE", "effect": "MODIFIED_SERVICE", "severity": "SEVERE" }
    // "versions": [...]              // present only when SEPTA edited the alert text
  },
  "detections": [],                   // bot detections (see below)
  "status": null                      // Regional Rail delay/cancellation status, else null
}
```

A Regional Rail delay:

```jsonc
{
  "id": "delay-2026-10-05-3556",
  "agency": "septa",
  "mode": "regional_rail",
  "routes": ["lan", "med"],           // every line the train was seen late on
  "sources": ["bot"],
  "lifecycle": { "first_seen_ts": …, "resolved_ts": …, "active": false, "duration_ms": … },
  "official_alert": null,
  "detections": [
    {
      "id": "delay-2026-10-05-3556",
      "source": "delay",              // "delay" or "cancellation"
      "scope": {
        "route": "lan",
        "from_station": "Wawa",       // the train's origin
        "to_station": "Doylestown",   // the train's destination
        "stations": [],
        "direction": null,
        "direction_label": "toward Doylestown"
      },
      "lifecycle": { "first_seen_ts": …, "onset_ts": null, "resolved_ts": …, "active": false, "duration_ms": … },
      "post_url": null,
      "description": "~22 min late — the 6:31 PM Wawa to Doylestown train (#3556)",
      "evidence": {
        "train_number": "3556",
        "details": { "late_min": 4, "max_late_min": 35, "last_stop": "Glenside", "last_seen_ts": …, "service": "LOCAL" },
        "updates": [ { "ts": …, "description": "22 min late at Fern Rock Transit Center", "evidence": { "late_min": 22 } } ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "status": {
    "type": "delay",                  // "delay" or "cancellation"
    "train_number": "3556",
    "delay_min": 35,                  // worst lateness seen
    "origin": "Wawa",
    "scheduled_departure_ts": …,      // from SEPTA's schedule for that train, when available
    "scheduled_arrival_ts": …
    // cancellations add "state": "upcoming" (before departure) or "cancelled"
  }
}
```

A bus gap (vehicle-position detection):

```jsonc
{
  "id": "gap-2026-10-06-17-0-0745",
  "agency": "septa",
  "mode": "bus",
  "routes": ["17"],
  "sources": ["bot"],
  "lifecycle": { "first_seen_ts": …, "resolved_ts": null, "active": true, "duration_ms": null },
  "official_alert": null,
  "detections": [
    {
      "id": "gap-2026-10-06-17-0-0745",
      "source": "gap",                // gap | bunching | ghost | pulse-held | trip-cancellations
      "scope": {
        "route": "17",
        "from_station": null,         // Metro (trolley/M1) detections name the nearest stations
        "to_station": null,
        "stations": [],
        "direction": "south",
        "direction_label": "toward 20th-Johnston"
      },
      "lifecycle": { "first_seen_ts": …, "onset_ts": …, "resolved_ts": null, "active": true, "duration_ms": null },
      "post_url": null,
      "resolved_post_url": null,
      "description": "~38 min between Route 17 buses toward 20th-Johnston — scheduled every ~15 min",
      "evidence": {
        "details": { "kind": "gap", "gap_min": 38, "headway_min": 15, "cancelled_between": 0, "vehicles": ["7480", "7483"], "worst": 38, "last_seen_ts": … },
        "updates": [ { "ts": …, "description": "…" } ],
        "resolved_description": null  // e.g. "Route 17 buses back to normal spacing." once resolved
      }
    }
  ],
  "status": null
}
```

`evidence.details` by source: `gap` — `gap_min`, `headway_min`, `cancelled_between`; `bunching` — `vehicle_count`, `distance_m`, `scheduled_spacing_min`, `headway_min`; `ghost` — `scheduled`, `tracked`, `missing`, `cancelled`, `usual_tracked_pct`; `pulse-held` (`kind: "held"`) — `vehicle_count`, `stationaryMs`; `trip-cancellations` — `service_date`, `cancelled`, `scheduled`, and `trips[]` (`trip_id`, `direction`, `start_ts`, `end_ts`, `origin`, `destination`).

## accessibility.json shape

```jsonc
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "generated_at": 1791245264003,
  "data_start_ts": 1791245264003,
  "window_days": 180,
  "outages": [
    {
      "id": "elevator-8th-market-eastbound-city-of-philadelphia-2026-10-05",
      "agency": "septa",
      "mode": "metro",                // "metro" or "regional_rail"
      "station": { "slug": "8th-market", "name": "8th-Market", "lines": ["l1", "b3"] },
      "unit_type": "elevator",
      "unit_label": "Eastbound (City of Philadelphia)",
      "headline": "8th-Market elevator out of service (Eastbound (City of Philadelphia))",
      "description": "No access to/from station",
      "lifecycle": { "first_seen_ts": …, "last_seen_ts": …, "restored_ts": null, "active": true },
      "source_url": "https://…"
    }
  ]
}
```

## alerts.csv columns

One row per official alert or detection (incidents flattened), with an explicit `record_type` column:

```
record_type, incident_id, agency, mode, routes, source, status_type, headline, description,
from_station, to_station, stations, direction, direction_label, first_seen_ts, onset_ts,
resolved_ts, duration_minutes, active, post_url, resolved_post_url, source_url
```

Timestamps are ISO 8601 (UTC); `routes` and `stations` are semicolon-separated when multi-valued.

## detection source glossary

- `delay` — a Regional Rail train running 15+ minutes late (TrainView).
- `cancellation` — a Regional Rail train SEPTA marked cancelled (TrainView).
- `trip-cancellations` — a bus or Metro route's trips SEPTA cancelled for one service day (GTFS-realtime).
- `gap` — two consecutive vehicles of a route pattern at least 20 minutes and twice the scheduled spacing apart (spacing = scheduled start + minutes late).
- `bunching` — mid-route vehicles scheduled at least 8 minutes apart running within 250 m of each other.
- `ghost` — at most half of a route's in-progress trips on SEPTA's tracker (at least three missing), on a route that's usually well tracked.
- `pulse-held` — two or more vehicles on a route stopped mid-route within 600 m of each other for 10+ minutes.

The site also understands `pulse-cold`, `thin-gap`, and `roundup` from the Chicago project's data shape; the SEPTA collector doesn't emit them.

"Disrupted time" figures on the site count unplanned disruptions only: planned work (SEPTA maintenance/construction advisories, advance-notice windows) is excluded, and so are `trip-cancellations` spans.

## Etiquette

Public data, no auth. Please cache responses, don't poll faster than every few minutes, and credit the project if you build something public. Changes to the shape are recorded in the data changelog.
